fixed: The stat targets' three tiers show on every build: the numbers behind them are read even where the catalog's source has not got them yet

added: Choose the build a character is graded by: "Use this build" on its page - the dashboard follows it, and the closest match to what the character wears stays marked beside it

Every build has stat targets in three tiers - basic, intermediate and advanced -, worked out for the weapon and the artifact set in hand, with your in-game totals beside them where the character came in by UID

updated: For the site's editors: every character in one table to choose from, a build's role, short name and constellation they can change, and a team's members side by side

added: Builds and their teams can carry the site's own notes - how to play them and what to watch for -, shown in Slovak to Slovak readers where one is written
updated: The site's editors can now correct a build or a team by hand between updates, so a mistake gets fixed sooner
A build's teams sit side by side on a phone too, with bigger portraits - and a build shows every team recommended for it
On your own characters' pages, a teammate you have wears a check on its portrait
A Traveler you have counts as yours in every element
Bigger portraits in the list of characters with builds
Artifact sets read more clearly: an option that any of several sets can fill no longer shows letters in place of a picture

added: Each build shows the teams it is played in, the best first: who to play it with, what each teammate does in the team, a constellation a team asks of one, and who can take a teammate's place

On your own characters' pages, the teammates you already have are marked - with a note where a team asks a higher constellation than yours - and each one takes you to your own analysis of that character
Each character's builds by what they are for - Main DPS, Sub DPS, Support - with a short name where a character has two of one kind, and the constellation a build needs: "Support · C4+"
The builds page can be filtered by element, weapon, rarity, region, the version a character came with, and name - and a link to the page keeps the filters
updated: Your best build follows your constellation: a build that needs one you do not have yet shows a lock, and is never counted as your best
Goals that depend on the constellation, such as Energy Recharge, are the ones for yours
Build Analyzer is now for Genshin Impact alone: Honkai: Star Rail accounts and builds are no longer kept

added: When you are signed in, the theme, the language and the way dates are written follow your anotoki account, the same on every anotoki site - and the theme and the language you choose at the top of the page are saved to your account
Signed in to your anotoki account on another anotoki site, you are signed in here too as soon as you open Build Analyzer - without a click
Feedback at the foot of every page: tell us what does not work, an idea or anything else - with your name, or without it
Terms, Privacy and Contact at the foot of every page: what Build Analyzer keeps about you, what for and how long, and how to reach us
updated: A new look, the same as the other anotoki sites: their colours, font, buttons, menus and dialogs - and the first page loads faster
While Build Analyzer is being updated, the page says so in your language instead of showing an error, and comes back by itself when the update is done
When signing in does not work, a page says why in your language, with Try again and Back
The grade letters and the marks beside each recommendation are easier to read, in the light theme and the dark
The element filter on your account shows each element's colour, a build's tab shows its score, and the import guide's steps, the import history and the score bars say more to a screen reader

added: The pages can be read in Slovak: choose the language at the top of the page
You can use the app without an account: what you import is kept for this browser for 30 days after your last visit, and moves into your anotoki account when you sign in
Once signed in, you can export your game accounts to a file and import them again - an import adds what is missing and keeps the newer copy of an account you have twice
When the site asks everybody to sign in first, what you imported without an account is kept, and moves into your account when you sign in
updated: One top bar, as on the other anotoki sites: the sections, the language, the theme and your menu - on a phone, all in one menu button
The version and What's new are now at the foot of every page

added: Export and Import on every source of the Sources page: a source's builds as a file, to keep as a backup or to take to another copy of the app
A source this server cannot reach can be synced on your own computer, exported there and imported here
Sign in with your anotoki account. The game accounts you import, and everything worked out from them, are visible to you only
The number at the top of the page shows the version you are using; click it to see what has changed
updated: The app has a new name: Build Analyzer
Build sources are now called Source 1, Source 2 and so on
Syncing builds happens on the Sources page in short steps, with a progress bar, and can be paused, resumed and cancelled
Character, weapon and set pictures now load from this site
Rebuilt behind the scenes to be lighter and quicker, so it runs on ordinary web hosting
